prompt:
Create a Japanese anime-style illustration of the character wearing a baby blue and white vertically striped off-the-shoulder blouse paired with a white pleated mini skirt.

The blouse has a wide off-shoulder neckline that exposes both shoulders, long soft balloon sleeves, and a light airy silhouette. The fabric pattern must be vertical blue-and-white stripes. The stripes run clearly from top to bottom across the main body and the sleeves. Keep the stripe direction vertical, not horizontal. Add a soft ruffle trim along the neckline, but keep the main blouse pattern vertically striped.

The skirt is a short white pleated mini skirt with a clean and slightly flared silhouette. 

Place the character on a bright city street in a sweet and stylish fashion pose. Give the character a cheerful and lovable expression.

upper-thigh-up framing, one complete scene, one character only. Keep the outfit clearly visible, especially the vertical stripe pattern, exposed shoulders, soft ruffle neckline, and white pleated mini skirt.

No collage, no split screen, no text, no logo.
